description_en: Performs a paged query for the list of published API products on a specified HiMarket developer portal. The paging result contains list items, each returning the publication record ID, API product ID, API product name, and API product type
description_zh: 分页查询指定 HiMarket 开发者门户上已发布的 API 产品列表，每个列表项返回发布记录 ID、API 产品 ID、API 产品名称与 API 产品类型
kebab_example: aliyun apig list-portal-publications --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --portal-id portal-xxxxxxxx --product-name model-service --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPortalPublications

parameters.help_en: The portal ID. Specifies the HiMarket developer portal for which to query published API products. You can obtain this ID from the portalId parameter in the CreatePortal response or from a list item in the ListPortals response. This ID is used in the /himarket/v1/portals/{portalId} path to locate the portal, the same path used by the GetPortal, UpdatePortal, and DeletePortal operations
parameters.help_zh: 门户 ID，指定要查询哪个 HiMarket 开发者门户的已发布 API 产品。可由 CreatePortal 响应的 portalId 或 ListPortals 列表项的 portalId 获得，与 GetPortal、UpdatePortal、DeletePortal 使用同一个 /himarket/v1/portals/{portalId} 路径来定位门户
parameters.name: portal_id

parameters.help_en: The API product name. This corresponds to the productName field in the response list items
parameters.help_zh: API 产品名称，与响应列表项中的 productName 为同一字段
parameters.name: product_name

content.description_en: The list of published API products on the portal. The list elements are named portalConfig, and each element represents an API product publication record
content.description_zh: 该门户上已发布的 API 产品列表，列表元素名为 portalConfig，每个元素为一条 API 产品发布记录

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 (RFC 3339) format in the UTC time zone, such as 2026-05-15T10:00:00Z
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，格式为 ISO 8601（RFC 3339），UTC 时区，例如 2026-05-15T10:00:00Z

description.description_en: The description of the API product
description.example: 面向内部开发者开放的模型服务 API 产品。

productId.description_en: The API product ID. This is the primary ID of the Product resource, which identifies the API product associated with this publication record
productId.description_zh: API 产品 ID，即 API 产品资源 Product 的一级 ID，标识本条发布记录对应的 API 产品

productName.description_en: The API product name. This is the Name property of the Product resource
productName.description_zh: API 产品名称，即 API 产品资源 Product 的 Name 属性

productType.description_en: The API product type. The valid values are not defined in the API specification. Refer to the types displayed in the console
productType.description_zh: API 产品类型。取值集合未在接口定义中声明，请以控制台展示的类型为准

publicationId.description_en: The publication record ID of the API product. This ID is returned when the PublishProduct operation publishes the API product to the portal. You can use it in the /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications/{publicationId} path to locate the publication record for the UnpublishProduct operation
publicationId.description_zh: API 产品的发布记录 ID，由 PublishProduct 发布 API 产品到门户时返回，可用于 UnpublishProduct 在 /himarket/v1/products/{productId}/publications/{publicationId} 路径中定位该发布记录

v1_parameters.help_en: The portal ID. Specifies the HiMarket developer portal for which to query published API products. You can obtain this ID from the portalId parameter in the CreatePortal response or from a list item in the ListPortals response. This ID is used in the /himarket/v1/portals/{portalId} path to locate the portal, the same path used by the GetPortal, UpdatePortal, and DeletePortal operations
v1_parameters.help_zh: 门户 ID，指定要查询哪个 HiMarket 开发者门户的已发布 API 产品。可由 CreatePortal 响应的 portalId 或 ListPortals 列表项的 portalId 获得，与 GetPortal、UpdatePortal、DeletePortal 使用同一个 /himarket/v1/portals/{portalId} 路径来定位门户
v1_parameters.name: portalId

v1_parameters.help_en: The API product name. This corresponds to the productName field in the response list items
v1_parameters.help_zh: API 产品名称，与响应列表项中的 productName 为同一字段
v1_parameters.name: productName
